description: Crosstalk: phones pick up overlapping speech, lines are fragmentary and share timestamps, and STT made errors. Invented people and facts.
lines: So the the server bill last month was
August. Twelve hundred. That's double July.
It's the logs, we're keeping every debug log for ninety days
Can we cut that to fourteen days?
Yes. I'll change the log retention to fourteen days today.
and the the staging box is still running, nobody uses it
Tom can you shut down staging then
sure I'll turn off the staging server after lunch
Should save maybe five hundred a month.
Good. Decision is fourteen day logs and no staging. Done.
